resolved_config.prompt_text:
NO BACKGROUND MUSIC. Natural diegetic sound effects only.

MANDATORY AUDIO: an otherwise completely silent soundtrack with ONLY the specifically listed tiny dry physical SFX. Each SFX is one short isolated event, followed immediately by absolute silence. ZERO MUSIC during the opening, action, cuts, ending and raw tail. Never fill quiet sections with sound. No score, soundtrack, musical transition, beat, melody, tonal drone, pulse, riser, sting, sustained texture, room tone or ambience. No speech or human vocal sound. Silence is the required default, including every shot without an explicit SFX cue.

Create one detailed cinematic ChronoStick vertical 9:16 sequence at 24 fps. Engine request 5.500000 seconds; H3 output 141 frames / 5.875000 seconds. The authored picture is frames 0–131, ending at 5.500000 seconds. Deliver 8 materially distinct shots joined by instantaneous hard cuts, then the specified resolved raw-tail hold. Pacing idea: Immediate mask curiosity, then a sharp date/era contrast.

Every visible pixel belongs to the approved illustrated stick-world: round off-white heads, sparse dot eyes/brows/closed mouths, narrow simplified bodies and limbs with detailed muted period/modern clothing, simple pale drawn hands, strong controlled dark contours, matte simplified surfaces and cinematic drawn shadows. Standard bodies retain roughly 5.0–5.8 head diameters; never broad realistic human anatomy. Architecture, water, stone, timber, wax, metal, foliage, clothes and smoke share that drawn rendering. No live action, photographic skin/textures/backgrounds, glossy 3D, anime or mixed style. No panels, grids, sheets, borders or inset views.

Binding ordered reference roles; the first scene anchor supplies rendering authority for every pixel, and the remaining reviewed anchors supply only their explicit scene/identity/prop states in the same style:

<Picture 1> is the mask-hand anchor. The hand-held-mask anchor controls exactly one detached pale simplified hand in a charcoal cuff and one ivory mask with black arched brows, black eye openings, curled moustache, pointed painted goatee and rose cheek marks, against a drawn slate wall. It controls every visible pixel in its shots; the mask is a prop, never a living historical face.

<Picture 2> is the westminster-exterior anchor. The riverside anchor controls the empty drawn medieval gabled stone complex, pitched slate roofs/finials, anchored tree shapes and river. This is a generic period setting, never modern clock-tower Westminster. No people/boats/text appear.

<Picture 3> is the palace-entrance-window anchor. The entrance anchor controls one pointed stone arch, a closed paired oak door with two iron ring handles, fixed stone steps and one right-side narrow window containing one lit candle. Crop only its existing door/window details; no figure at the window.

Keep exact scene-specific counts, colors, head/hair/headwear silhouettes, costume cuts, owners and object shapes. Crops exclude other anchored subjects instead of duplicating or transforming them. Preserve screen placement within each setting and advance only through the explicit phases below. One primary action, at most one simple camera move and no more than the stated low-amplitude secondary motion per shot; never frantic motion or choreography. The era/location changes only on the listed hard cuts. Empty object inserts contain only their explicit inventory.

HARD CUT — C01-S01: 0.000000–0.666667 s; frames 0–15. mask-hand scene/crop.

Framing: Tight frontal mask, slightly tilted; 70 percent frame height. Visible inventory: Zero complete people; one ivory mask and one pale charcoal-sleeved holding hand; slate wall. Light/palette: Warm upper-left drawn key and cool slate right fill; matte outlined ivory/charcoal/rose accents.

Primary action: The held mask tilts only five degrees then stops. Camera: Fixed eye-level camera. Resolved end: The held mask tilts only five degrees then stops; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Only one quiet dry cue: one dry sleeve brush, local 0.083333–0.208333 s; stop completely at the cue endpoint. Silence throughout the rest of this shot.

HARD CUT — C01-S02: 0.666667–1.291667 s; frames 16–30. mask-hand scene/crop.

Framing: Extreme hand/ivory edge crop, fingers simplified. Visible inventory: One pale hand, charcoal cuff and one mask edge; no face or extra hand. Light/palette: Warm upper-left drawn key and cool slate right fill; matte outlined ivory/charcoal/rose accents.

Primary action: The same hand raises the edge two centimetres then holds. Camera: Fixed close camera. Resolved end: The same hand raises the edge two centimetres then holds; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.

HARD CUT — C01-S03: 1.291667–1.958333 s; frames 31–46. mask-hand scene/crop.

Framing: One black eye opening fills the upper-middle frame. Visible inventory: One cropped ivory mask eye and black eyebrow, slate background; no living eye or person. Light/palette: Warm upper-left drawn key and cool slate right fill; matte outlined ivory/charcoal/rose accents.

Primary action: Hold the eye opening completely still. Camera: One tiny 2-percent push, settled four frames before cut. Resolved end: Hold the eye opening completely still; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.

HARD CUT — C01-S04: 1.958333–2.625000 s; frames 47–62. mask-hand scene/crop.

Framing: Moustache/goatee prop insert; iconic curved black paint. Visible inventory: One ivory mask lower-face crop with black moustache and pointed painted goatee; no human mouth or face. Light/palette: Warm upper-left drawn key and cool slate right fill; matte outlined ivory/charcoal/rose accents.

Primary action: Hold the painted mask surface unchanged. Camera: Fixed macro feeling, drawn edges crisp. Resolved end: Hold the painted mask surface unchanged; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.

HARD CUT — C01-S05: 2.625000–3.541667 s; frames 63–84. mask-hand scene/crop.

Framing: Full mask returned to center, different scale from opening. Visible inventory: One mask, one charcoal-sleeved pale hand; no worn mask or visible wearer. Light/palette: Warm upper-left drawn key and cool slate right fill; matte outlined ivory/charcoal/rose accents.

Primary action: The holding hand settles the mask into a still frontal pose. Camera: Fixed eye-level close frame. Resolved end: The holding hand settles the mask into a still frontal pose; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.

HARD CUT — C01-S06: 3.541667–4.500000 s; frames 85–107. westminster-exterior scene/crop.

Framing: Wide riverside medieval stone complex, gables above water. Visible inventory: One linked period stone complex, pitched roofs/finials from anchor, trees and river; zero people, boats or clock tower. Light/palette: Warm amber screen-left/practical key and cool right shadows; drawn ochre/umber/slate stone or timber, muted costumes.

Primary action: One small water ripple passes and resolves. Camera: Fixed wide view, no architecture redesign. Resolved end: One small water ripple passes and resolves; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Only one quiet dry cue: one very brief soft water lap, local 3.625000–3.750000 s; stop completely at the cue endpoint. Silence throughout the rest of this shot.

HARD CUT — C01-S07: 4.500000–4.958333 s; frames 108–118. palace-entrance-window scene/crop.

Framing: Tight pointed entrance and closed paired oak door. Visible inventory: One pointed arch, two oak leaves, two iron ring handles and stone steps; no person; window cropped out. Light/palette: Warm amber screen-left/practical key and cool right shadows; drawn ochre/umber/slate stone or timber, muted costumes.

Primary action: Hold both door leaves firmly closed. Camera: One 2-percent forward move, settled by final three frames. Resolved end: Hold both door leaves firmly closed; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.

HARD CUT — C01-S08: 4.958333–5.500000 s; frames 119–131. palace-entrance-window scene/crop.

Framing: One narrow window with a burning candle. Visible inventory: One drawn window and one lit candle; closed entry door outside crop, no silhouettes. Light/palette: Warm amber screen-left/practical key and cool right shadows; drawn ochre/umber/slate stone or timber, muted costumes.

Primary action: The tiny candle flame bends once then returns upright. Camera: Fixed tight window insert. Resolved end: The tiny candle flame bends once then returns upright; all primary motion settles before the cut.

Silence in this shot; do not invent a cue, voice or ambience bed.



Resolved raw tail: local 5.500000–5.875000 s, frames 132–140 inclusive. Continue the last resolved composition with camera, people, hands, props, light and environment locked; no new action/cut/sound in the raw tail.

Every cut is instantaneous and exact; no dissolve, temporal morph, whip-pan masking, speed ramp or unplanned scene. Zero dialogue, narration, lip sync, subtitles, readable writing, numbers, labels or buttons. Painted mask features remain fixed. Never add an unlisted person, hand, animal, prop or background event; no duplicated characters, costume/prop swaps, multiplying objects or unresolved action.

FINAL AUDIO CHECK: absolutely zero background music throughout. Only listed brief dry non-tonal physical cues; silence between events and in the entire raw tail. Never add an atmospheric or musical bed. No singing, speech, whispers, human vocalization or voices.
